from object_detector_tool import tool

# Path of the image file
image_path = "/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_27_image_1.jpg"

# Detection parameters
labels = ["baseball", "basket"]
threshold = 0.5
model_size = "tiny"
padding = 20

# Execute the tool
execution = tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=labels, threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size, padding=padding)

# Get the detected objects
objects = execution["output_type"]

# Count the number of people laying down
count_people = 0
for object_dict in objects:
    if object_dict["label"] == "person":
        count_people += 1

final_result = f"{count_people} people are laying down."
